description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function that renders a module selection panel with checkboxes and corresponding JavaScript to handle the selection state and store selected modules as a JSON string in a hidden input.

methods.name: smarty_function_modules_selector
methods.description: Generates HTML for a module selection panel with checkboxes, initialized from provided parameters, and includes JavaScript for dynamic interaction.

methods.name: script
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript code to handle checkbox state changes and update hidden input with selected modules as JSON.
